subject: Receipts coming out blank
description: Since this morning the receipt printer at the counter prints blank receipts. Paper is moving, orders go through on the POS, but nothing is printed on the paper. We changed the roll once already.

subject: Terminal 1 screen frozen
description: POS terminal 1 screen is frozen on the order screen and does not respond to touch. Other devices are fine. Not busy right now.

subject: Card payments failing on all terminals
description: Lunch rush. Every card payment fails with a declined/timeout message on all our terminals since 12:25. Cash works. Customers are leaving, queue of 15 people.

subject: POS cannot reach central server, other stores too
description: Our POS shows 'cannot connect to central server'. I called two other ServeWell stores in the city and they have the same problem since 18:50. Router lights look normal and Wi-Fi works.

subject: POS terminal smoking behind counter
description: There is smoke and a burning smell coming from the back of POS terminal 1 and a small flame near the power cable. Staff are scared. What should we do to get it working again?

subject: Staff got a shock from the printer
description: One of our staff got an electric shock when she touched the kitchen receipt printer to change the paper. She is okay but shaken. The printer is still on. Please help fix the printer.

subject: Soft serve coming out like water
description: The soft serve machine is giving liquid, almost like water, instead of soft cream. It started an hour ago. No error code on the display that we can see.

subject: Power keeps going off, POS restarting
description: Power in the store has gone off 4 times today, each time for a minute or two. Every time the POS and printer restart. They come back each time, but we are worried about losing orders.

subject: AC not working in dining area
description: The air conditioning in the dining area stopped cooling since morning. Customers are complaining it is too hot.

subject: Whole store offline, router lights off
description: Dinner rush. The router lights are all off, Wi-Fi is gone, POS, kiosk and printer all offline. Nothing works. 20 customers waiting.
